items.summary: Recommendation: create no new site proposals or change requests this cycle. Existing work and repair capacity are occupied: 197 approved proposals lack execution requests, 46 failure follow-ups remain open, 29 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. The portfolio snapshot shows 103 SEO actions across 39 sites, including 55 high-priority items, but the authoritative candidate list is empty and several opportunities already have active or deferred work. Continue source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded compliance/security evidence work. Product findings to retain as deferred backlog: improve information hierarchy and accessible CTA patterns only where site-specific evidence and queue capacity support it; address evidenced performance issues such as americastrikes.com mobile performance 64 with LCP 4,789ms and TBT 700ms; and prioritize high-impression SEO pages already in the existing queue. Do not infer audience fit, revenue, causal lift, or accessibility compliance where evidence is absent. Revenue remains limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 with $0 site-attributed commission; no monetization expansion is justified.
